name: SAM.gov Contract Opportunities
known_limitations: Notices can be amended, canceled, superseded, or remain pre-award; an opportunity does not establish an award, obligation, delivery, acceptance, or outcome.
automation_notes: Preserve notice ID, type, agency, dates, solicitation number, amendment history, and status; separate opportunity, award, obligation, and performance.
notes: Official discovery rail for pre-solicitation, solicitation, award, and sole-source notices.
